metadata.description: Agent skills and plugins for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity.

plugins.name: adveloop
plugins.description: GAN-inspired adversarial dev loop — Planner sequentially drives a Generator and Evaluator in fresh cmux panes, with a hard pass/fail gate per deliverable. Adapted from Anthropic's harness-design guidance for long-running agentic apps.

plugins.name: cmux
plugins.description: Skill for orchestrating independent Claude Code sessions in cmux terminal — split panes, agent monitoring, browser automation, sidebar metadata, notifications, and full CLI coverage.

plugins.name: refine-prompt
plugins.description: Interview-style prompt refiner that picks a framework, fills gaps via AskUserQuestion, assembles a structured XML prompt, confirms, then executes it. In Claude Code, adds a refine prompt button above the prompt box.

plugins.name: relamo
plugins.description: Recursive Language Model skill — programmatic codebase exploration via persistent Python REPL loop

plugins.name: agy
plugins.description: Use Antigravity from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: wisci
plugins.description: WISCI context engineering framework — Write, Isolate, Select, Compress, Iterate. Staleness-tracked context store (.wisci/), per-stream handoffs with a derived index, proactive session hooks, and context-enriched commits.
